title: 16 · HELIX — The LehroSol Terminal Design System
description: **HELIX** is LehroSol's terminal design system: one zero-dependency source of truth for color, typography, glyphs, spacing, motion, and component primitives shared across the CLI *and* the in-terminal GUI ([the HELIX Console](15-terminal-gui.md)). The goal is blunt — an agentic terminal experience that **out-classes every other CLI agent tool**: immersive, legible, and consistent at every stage, on every terminal.
